objective.title: Create a locally stored greeting artifact and verify its content
objective.description: Synthetic demonstration objective for the OAES v2 reference runtime. It exists solely to prove Objective completion through deterministic Action selection, the four Knowledge States, dependency ordering, persistence, and resumption.

success_criteria.description: The greeting content requirement is Verified.
The greeting artifact exists on disk with the required content and is Verified.

knowledge.content: The greeting artifact must contain exactly: Hello, OAES!
A file greeting.txt exists in the demo working directory and its content matches the requirement k-greeting-content.
